title: Projektetage Column Text Morph
description: Fix projektetage tiles-to-text transition: all column tiles should morph into one shared label per column (not first tile to text then text to stack). Use column ghost bridge slide and columnMorphId labels.
summary:
Fixed catalogue tiles→labels transition so each column merges into one shared text morph instead of the first tile becoming text then moving.

- Renderer: when `columnMorphTiles` is set, render hidden per-column ghost slots (`columnMorphId`) alongside tiles on the focus arrangement; `columnGhostsOnly` shows only those ghosts (tiles omitted).
- Projektetage: added `catalogue-column-ghosts` bridge arrangement; labels use `columnMorphId` only (removed `morphColumnGroups` per-tile expansion).
- Tests and AGENTS.md updated. Verified on :6050: focus has 10 tiles + 3 hidden column ghosts; ghosts slide has 3 shown ghosts; labels slide has 3 `catalogue--column--*` ids.
